   tier-1 namespace/derivation joins (every `1g` evidence kind carries a

   detected and disclosed, never re-judged); M check evaluates the

   (0 flagged statements / 0 figures without a basis class over the

5. **Gold-set provenance relabelled "agent" (F-512)** —

6. **The ER re-run (pre-authorised mutation — engineered, QUEUED)** —
